questions.q: Core: Fill in a claimant card for each of the three: who, where from, reason, strength, weakness.
Extend: Rank the claims from strongest to weakest with a reason.
questions.a: Any ranking with reasons, for example Harold first because the Witan chose him

questions.q: Stretch: Why did a promise matter so much in 1066?
questions.a: People believed oaths were sacred; breaking one was seen as very wrong
